responsibility: Implements GCC’s constraint-based tree points-to analysis solver. It builds field-sensitive set constraints for scalar, dereference, and address-of expressions; assigns variable and field IDs; solves copy, direct, and complex constraints over the constraint graph; derives per-pointer pt_solution sets and call use/clobber sets; and provides both intra-procedural and IPA points-to computation that feeds the alias oracle in tree-ssa-alias.cc.
